svg.title: How a translation reaches its readers
svg.desc: A translator corrects or adds a text in l10n/fr.json, the catalog of French, and the summary and the description in French in appinfo/info.xml. node scripts/check-l10n.mjs --fix writes l10n/fr.js, which the browser loads, from the catalog. The check of the translations then asks whether every text of the code has its translation, with its placeholders and the forms of its plurals, whether l10n/fr.js holds the same as l10n/fr.json, and whether appinfo/info.xml has a summary and a description in French. If not, its output names each problem and its fix. If so, the pull request is merged and released, and Nextcloud shows the settings, the notes in Files, the Activity stream and the notifications in French to every account set to French, a new French instance proposes the French folder names, and the App Store shows the summary and the description in French.
